notes.title: New patch available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. A new patch has just been released, adding support for the Japanese language and the following fixes:
	
[list]
[*]Frame rate optimizations.
[*]Various fixes on custom bike liveries.
[*]Collision and graphic fixes on some tracks.
[/list]

Thank you so much for all the feedback you've sent us in the last few weeks. We're doing our best to solve most of the issues you have reported. Keep it up!

notes.title: RE-LIVE THE 2015 SEASON WITH MXGP2 REAL EVENTS 2015 GAME MODE
notes.notes:
Milestone announces the Real Events 2015 Game Mode for MXGP2. The game will be available on April 7th 2016 for PlayStation®4, Xbox One®, the all-in-one games and entertainment system and Windows PC®/STEAM™.

In MXGP2 19 Real Events, 18 for GP and 1 for MXoN, will be available. The player can relive the moments that have characterized the 2015 edition of the Championship. Players can change the destiny of Ryan Villopoto against Antonio Cairoli during the MXGP of Qatar after a starting trouble, overtake Gautier Paulin, be in the boots of Shaun Simpson during the MXGP of Belgium and much more.

notes.title: ANNOUNCED BIKE AND RIDER CUSTOMIZATION & ANNOUNCED THE INTRODUCTION OF TEST TRACK GAME MODE
notes.notes:
[img] http://cdnext.mxgpvideogame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/THUMBS-customization.jpg [/img]

With the rider and bike customization racing is even more electrifying. 
Feel like a real star of motocross, customize your rider, create an exclusive set up for your bike and take to the track! 
In ‪#‎MXGPvideogame‬ you have the possibility to create your own rider, choosing from several options. 
In particular, the editable elements include:
• Helmet
• Goggles
• Neckbrace
• Racewear
• Boots
But that’s not all! Change your name, number and the font on your suit racewear and choose your nationality. Into a real garage you will set up your bike and change some parts like graphics, tires, suspension, accessories, exhausts and much much more.
But how to understand you've got a high-performance vehicle for beating any rival? [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DDBTIrd1maU&feature=youtu.be] Learn more![/url]

notes.title: Announced the Monster Energy FIM Motocross of Nations game mode
notes.notes:
[img] https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CcJvxT-UYAETqON.jpg:large[/img]

Hey Crazy Crossers! 

We are happy to announce the introduction of the brand new MONSTER ENERGY FIM MOTOCROSS OF NATIONS Game Mode in ‪#‎MXGPvideogame‬! ‪

[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gDwqvYXx0GY&feature=youtu.be] Watch the video![/url][/h1]

#‎MXoN‬ is a team event scheduled at the end of the World Championship, in which the riders of each Nation compete representing their own country.
In this new game mode you'll choose from a selection of 11 Nations and live the challenge with no holds barred and jumps. Each team consists of 3 riders from 3 different classes: MXGP, MX2 and Open.
You’ll be able to choose between 6 iconic tracks:
•	Lommel
•	Teutschenthal
•	Kegums
•	Ernèe (2015)
•	Maggiora
•	Glen Helen

Are you ready to start the competition and get the best score?‪#‎InTheHEARTofMotocross‬


Milestone Team

Hey Crazy Crossers! 

We are happy to announce the introduction of the brand new MONSTER ENERGY FIM MOTOCROSS OF NATIONS Game Mode in ‪#‎MXGPvideogame‬! ‪

[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gDwqvYXx0GY&feature=youtu.be] Watch the video![/url][/h1]

#‎MXoN‬ is a team event scheduled at the end of the World Championship, in which the riders of each Nation compete representing their own country.
In this new game mode you'll choose from a selection of 11 Nations and live the challenge with no holds barred and jumps. Each team consists of 3 riders from 3 different classes: MXGP, MX2 and Open.
You’ll be able to choose between 6 iconic tracks:
•	Lommel
•	Teutschenthal
•	Kegums
•	Ernèe (2015)
•	Maggiora
•	Glen Helen

Are you ready to start the competition and get the best score?‪#‎InTheHEARTofMotocross‬


Milestone Team

notes.title: STADIUM SERIES Game Mode
notes.notes:
Hey Crazy Crossers! We are happy to announce a new GREAT experience in ‪#‎MXGPvideogame‬: the STADIUM SERIES game mode!

Motocross tracks and stadiums for the first time together! 

The track and jump structure are very technical and spectacular, so you'll prove your skills in two stadiums types, each with two unique layouts for a total of four tracks:

•	Football Arena 1 
•	Football Arena 2
•	Diamond Stadium 1 
•	Diamond Stadium 2

Jumps, dirt and pure emotion. Are you ready? ‪#‎InTheHEARTofMotocross‬
